description: The product of a natural-number list is its left fold under multiplication starting at \(1\), including the empty list.
signature:
List.prod_eq_foldl.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [One α] [Mul α] [Std.Associative fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2]
  [Std.LawfulIdentity (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) 1] {xs : List α} : xs.prod = List.foldl (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) 1 xs
